$comment: Site-owned. D1 Picks growth loop: tournament and ratings EXPLAINERS ONLY (seeding, RPI, bracketology, ratings), written as MDX guides under /guides from NCAA and governing-body pages, each paired with our own ratings and results pages. The loop never writes predictions, picks, ratings or results: those are the pipeline's surfaces (pipeline/, data/volleyball/, content/volleyball-games/) and it has its own caps, which the loop does not share. allow.patterns is a hard allowlist; skip.patterns blocks betting and every sport but women's volleyball. See docs/growth/strategy.md. Anthropic cap is $2 a month (the kit's per-site share of ~$20).

requiredBlocks.markdown:
## See it in our data

Our [volleyball ratings](/volleyball/ratings) rate every D1 team from this season's results, and our [graded results](/results) show how every logged prediction did. Both update daily from the model, and this guide uses neither to say who will win.
